scope.description: Conservative offline policy for the resource-backed Quest1-8 client dialogue chain. It records SELECT, STEP2 SCRIPT, the first STEP3 CANCEL, and an explicit reward evidence gap for each script; it does not implement or assert server gameplay behavior.

safetyPolicy: Every B6 record is RECOVERED_SECONDARY and runtimeVerified=false; no record is VERIFIED.
QuestN script number is a filename/resource identifier only, not a server-internal quest ID.
Actor tokens are retained as strings exactly as supplied by the marker-local S4 evidence; no NPC template/entity/SMF numeric join is performed.
B5 quest_semantic is used only as a source-declared QuestN semantic cross-reference; it does not prove Actor-to-entity identity.
B5 NPC placement candidates remain offline-policy and must not be described as retail NPC identity or retail placement.
No task acceptance, condition evaluation, completion acknowledgement, recruitment mutation, reward award, warp, battle, save, wire emission, or runtime NPC deployment is implemented.
The 13 additional CANCEL markers remain source references and are not promoted to independent B6 chain stages.
Quest0, Quest9, and NPCScript program47 remain deferred.
